title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
walmart is seeking a Staff Software Engineer who is passionate about building innovative solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-growing organization.

**About the Role:**
As a Staff Software Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our tech capabilities. You will work closely with our product, engineering, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

**What You'll Do:**
- Lead and execute tech initiatives from conception to delivery
- Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities
- Develop and implement strategies that align with company goals
- Analyze data and metrics to measure impact and drive improvements
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices
- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners

**Your Background:**
- 5+ years of relevant experience
- Expertise in Agile, Communication, React, Team Management
- Proven track record of delivering results in a fast-paced environment
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities

**Compensation & Benefits:**
- Annual salary: KHR 50,000 – KHR 80,000
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Stock options / performance bonus
- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
- Flexible working hours

title: Principal DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for a talented Principal DevOps Engineer to join our dynamic team at Stripe. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining tech solutions that drive business growth and innovation.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs
- Mentor junior team members and share knowledge across the organization
- Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand business requirements

**Requirements:**
- 9 years of experience in a similar role
- Strong proficiency in Python, Docker, Stakeholder Management, Git
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience
- Strong communication and collaboration skills

**What We Offer:**
- Competitive salary of KHR 18,000 – KHR 30,000 per year
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

title: Lead Event Manager
description:
We are looking for a talented Lead Event Manager to join our dynamic team at Home Depot. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining general solutions that drive business growth and innovation.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs
- Mentor junior team members and share knowledge across the organization
- Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand business requirements

**Requirements:**
- 3 years of experience in a similar role
- Strong proficiency in Leadership, Problem Solving, Communication, Project Management
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience
- Strong communication and collaboration skills

**What We Offer:**
- Competitive salary of KHR 50,000 – KHR 80,000 per year
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

We are looking for a talented Junior IT Support Specialist to join our dynamic team at Apple. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining general solutions that drive business growth and innovation.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs
- Mentor junior team members and share knowledge across the organization
- Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand business requirements

- 5 years of experience in a similar role
- Strong proficiency in Project Management, Analytical Thinking, Team Management, Leadership
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience
- Strong communication and collaboration skills

**What We Offer:**
- Competitive salary of KHR 10,000 – KHR 18,000 per year
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment
